identity_review: The operator’s April 9, 2024 guidance page 9 names Suzukakedai G4-A as the building converted into the TSUBAME4 data center, with a named exterior photo and campus map. Current operator visitor information explicitly locates TSUBAME4 at Yokohama (formerly Suzukakedai), excluding Ookayama. The university’s current campus map lists G4-A as building 34, and its April 2026 renaming announcement bridges the two campus names. A name-only Google Maps search returned and the browser selected the exact Yokohama host campus at 4259 Nagatsutacho with the official isct.ac.jp website. The original selected-place response pairs the campus name and feature ID with its coordinates, separate from viewport coordinates. The selected point is the wider university host campus, not the identified G4-A building itself.
precision: Wider Yokohama university host-campus marker for the TSUBAME4 data center in G4-A. It does not map the G4-A building, machine room, cooling plant, entrance or surveyed campus boundary.
